# Virtual Key Solutions

Virtual Key Solutions is a web design and digital solutions agency that positions itself as a builder of 'digital real estate' — using architectural and real estate metaphors throughout its brand identity (e.g., 'LOT: 002', 'structural audit', 'digital location'). The brand blends a modern, tech-forward aesthetic with a grounded, results-driven message focused on local and service businesses. Their tone is confident and professional, emphasizing tangible business outcomes like calls, leads, and bookings over vanity metrics, and presenting their websites as 24/7 salespeople for their clients.

## Most Business Websites Don't Actually Bring in Customers


Many websites look fine on the surface — but fail where it matters most. If your site isn't generating calls, leads, or bookings, it isn't working. It's just occupying digital space.




- No Calls. No Leads. No Bookings. Your site attracts visitors but converts none of them into real business enquiries.

- Poor Mobile Usability Over 70% of local searches happen on phones. If your site breaks on mobile, so does your revenue.

- Outdated & Untrusted Appearance Customers judge credibility in seconds. An outdated design signals an outdated business — and they move on.

- No Clear Next Step for Customers Confused visitors don't convert. Without a clear path, they leave without ever contacting you.




RESULT:
Traffic comes in… and leaves.





Our custom website design services are engineered to fix every one of these failure points — turning your digital address into a 24/7 salesperson that earns trust and drives real growth.

### Custom Website Design

Strong first impressions that build lasting trust.










A-02





### Mobile Optimization


Built to perform seamlessly across phones, tablets, and desktops. Over 60% of your customers are browsing on mobile — a slow or broken mobile experience costs you real calls and real revenue. We ensure every interaction is fast, fluid, and frictionless on every screen size.



More calls and inquiries from mobile visitors.










A-03





### Lead Generation Systems


Your website should work as your best salesperson — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. We design and integrate strategic lead capture systems including contact forms, click-to-call prompts, and inquiry funnels that automatically route potential customers directly to your business.



Automated inquiries captured around the clock.










A-04





### Local Search Visibility


Dominate your digital location. We optimize your web presence so your business appears prominently when local customers search for the services you offer. From on-page SEO to Google Business Profile alignment, we put your business on the map — literally and strategically.



Found first by the customers who matter most.










A-05





### Speed & Performance


A slow website loses customers before they ever read your offer. We conduct structural performance audits and implement technical optimizations — image compression, code efficiency, server response tuning — so your site loads fast, ranks higher, and keeps visitors engaged from the first second.



Faster load times that keep visitors from leaving.










A-06





### Hosting & Security


Your digital real estate needs a solid foundation. We provide managed hosting and security infrastructure that keeps your site online, protected, and performing reliably — 365 days a year. SSL certificates, malware monitoring, and regular backups ensure long-term business continuity.



Rock-solid reliability that protects your reputation.

LOT: 007

KNOWLEDGE BASE


## Frequently Asked Questions


Everything you need to know about working with Virtual Key Solutions — from first conversation to launch day and beyond. If you don't see your question here, we're always happy to talk.














### What does Virtual Key Solutions actually do?


We design and build professional websites for local and service-based businesses — and we back them with digital marketing strategy. Think of us as architects of your digital real estate: we construct an online presence that earns trust, generates calls, and converts visitors into paying customers. Every site we build is engineered for visibility, credibility, and consistent growth.





### Who do you typically work with?


We work primarily with local and service-based businesses — contractors, clinics, consultants, tradespeople, hospitality operators, and professional service providers. If your business depends on phone calls, bookings, or in-person visits, we're built for you. Our custom website design services are tailored to businesses that need real-world results, not just an online presence.





### Why does a professional website matter so much?


Your website is your most visible business asset — operating 24/7 even when you're not. A professional site builds instant trust, clearly communicates your value, and guides visitors toward taking action. Without it, you're losing customers to competitors who made the investment. A poorly built site is worse than none: it signals neglect and drives people away before they ever call.





### What makes Virtual Key Solutions different from other agencies?


We don't chase vanity metrics. Our focus is on outcomes that matter to your business: calls, leads, and bookings. We treat every project as a structural build — not a template swap. Our brand philosophy of 'digital real estate' means we approach your website the way a skilled developer approaches a property: with precision, purpose, and long-term value in mind. You get a dedicated team, not a ticket queue.





### Will my website be mobile-friendly?


Absolutely — mobile optimization is non-negotiable in every project we deliver. Over 60% of web traffic comes from mobile devices, and Google ranks mobile-first. Every site we build performs seamlessly across phones, tablets, and desktops. We test rigorously across device sizes so your customers have a flawless experience regardless of how they find you.





### Can you redesign my existing website?


Yes — redesigns are a significant part of what we do. We begin with a structural audit of your current site to diagnose what's failing and why. From there, we rebuild with purpose: improved layout, stronger messaging, faster load times, and a clear conversion path. We preserve what's working and replace what isn't. Most clients see immediate improvements in engagement and lead quality after a redesign.





### Do you help with Google visibility and local SEO?


Yes. Every site we build is structured for search engine visibility from the ground up — proper heading hierarchy, fast load speeds, clean code, and on-page SEO fundamentals. We also offer dedicated local SEO services including Google Business Profile optimisation, local citation building, and keyword targeting for your service area. Being found in your digital location is just as important as having a great site.





### Is the consultation really free?


Yes, completely. Your initial consultation with us carries no cost and no obligation. We use that time to understand your business, your goals, and where your current digital presence is falling short. You'll leave with clarity on what's needed — whether you choose to work with us or not. We believe in earning your trust before asking for your investment.










### How long does it take to build a website?


Most projects are completed within 2–4 weeks from the time we have all the necessary content and approvals in hand. Complex builds with custom functionality or larger site architectures may take 4–6 weeks. We provide a clear project timeline at the outset and keep you informed at every stage. Speed matters to us — but never at the cost of quality or structural integrity.





### Do I need to provide my own content and images?


We work with whatever you have — and fill the gaps where you don't. If you have brand photos and written copy ready, we'll incorporate them seamlessly. If you need content written or professional imagery sourced, we offer copywriting and curated stock photography as part of our service packages. Our goal is to remove every obstacle between you and a finished, high-performing website.





### What is a 'preview period' and how does it work?


Before your site goes live, we share a private staging link so you can review every page in detail. This preview period gives you the opportunity to request adjustments, refine copy, and confirm every element meets your expectations. We don't launch until you're satisfied. It's our quality checkpoint — ensuring the final product is exactly what was agreed upon, with no surprises.





### Who owns the website once it's built?


You do — fully and completely. Upon final payment, all design assets, content, and website files belong to you. We don't lock you into proprietary systems that hold your site hostage. Your domain, your hosting account, your business. We believe in building relationships based on results, not dependency. You stay because we deliver value — not because you have no choice.





### Do you offer ongoing support after launch?


Yes. We offer ongoing maintenance and support packages for clients who want peace of mind after launch. This covers software updates, security monitoring, minor content edits, and performance checks. Think of it as a property management service for your digital real estate — keeping everything running smoothly so you can focus on your business. One-off support is also available as needed.





### How is pricing structured?


Our pricing is project-based and transparent — no hidden fees, no surprise invoices. Every proposal includes a detailed scope of work so you know exactly what you're getting and what it costs. We offer packages suited to different business sizes and needs, from foundational digital storefronts to full custom website design and development builds with integrated marketing. Contact us for a tailored quote specific to your goals.





### What platforms do you build on?


We build on platforms best suited to your business needs — most commonly WordPress, with custom themes and no bloated page builders that slow sites down. For e-commerce requirements, we work with Shopify and WooCommerce. Our recommendations are always based on what will perform best for your specific use case, not what's easiest for us to build on. The right foundation matters.





### How do I get started?


Getting started is straightforward. Reach out via our contact page or call us directly to book your free consultation. We'll discuss your business, your goals, and your current digital situation. From there, we put together a tailored proposal. No pressure, no hard sell — just a clear picture of what's possible and what it takes to get there. Your digital real estate is waiting to be built.



























READY TO BUILD YOUR DIGITAL LOCATION?

Our team is ready to walk you through every detail — from structure to strategy. Whether you're starting from scratch or upgrading an underperforming site, we'll help you claim your digital location and turn it into your most reliable source of leads, calls, and bookings.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/26/2026



Virtual Key Solutions ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Virtual Key Solutions

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 26, 2026



Virtual Key Solutions is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Virtual Key Solutions

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
